events.description: Sends the words; resolves with the proposal, or `null` when there is nothing to propose.
events.name: onAsk

events.description: Called with the proposal when the person applies it.
events.name: onApply

events.description: Called when the person discards the proposal.
events.name: onDiscard

props.description: Draws the proposal under the box.
props.name: renderProposal

props.description: The box's name. Defaults to "Ask Tamo".
props.name: label

props.description: The hint inside the empty box. Defaults to "Ask in your own words".
props.name: placeholder

props.description: True for a multi-line box (pasted text).
props.name: isMultiline

props.description: True to put the focus in the box when it mounts (it opened in a popover the person asked for).
props.name: isAutoFocus
